description: This file contains various utility functions for linear algebra operations used internally in PyTorch, such as tensor type checks, matrix multiplication, eigen-decomposition, and basis computations.

methods.name: is_sparse(A)
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a sparse COO tensor.

methods.name: get_floating_dtype(A)
methods.description: Returns the floating point dtype of a tensor, defaults to float32 for integer types.

methods.name: Tensor matmul(A: Tensor | None, B: Tensor)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication, supports sparse and dense tensors.

methods.name: Tensor bform(X: Tensor, A: Tensor | None, Y: Tensor)
methods.description: Calculates the bilinear form: X^T A Y.

methods.name: qform(A: Tensor | None, S: Tensor)
methods.description: Calculates the quadratic form: S^T A S.

methods.name: basis(A)
methods.description: Returns an orthogonal basis for the columns of matrix A.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] symeig(A: Tensor, largest: bool | None = False)
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a symmetric matrix.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor] eig( self: Tensor, eigenvectors: bool = False, *, e=None, v=None, )
tuple[Tensor,Tensor] lstsq(input: Tensor, A: Tensor, *, out=None)
tuple[Tensor,Tensor] solve(input: Tensor, A: Tensor, *, out=None)

ctags.name: bform
ctags.pattern: /^def bform(X: Tensor, A: Tensor | None, Y: Tensor) -> Tensor:$/
ctags.signature: (X: Tensor, A: Tensor | None, Y: Tensor)

ctags.name: eig
ctags.signature: ( self: Tensor, eigenvectors: bool = False, *, e=None, v=None, )

ctags.name: lstsq
ctags.pattern: /^def lstsq(input: Tensor, A: Tensor, *, out=None) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:$/

ctags.name: matmul
ctags.pattern: /^def matmul(A: Tensor | None, B: Tensor) -> Tensor:$/

ctags.name: solve
ctags.pattern: /^def solve(input: Tensor, A: Tensor, *, out=None) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:$/

ctags.name: symeig
ctags.pattern: /^def symeig(A: Tensor, largest: bool | None = False) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]:$/
